description.text:
To support our teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, we’re looking to add an Staff/Sr. Firmware Engineer (BMC Control Module) located in Taiwan Taipei Wugu Site.
What a typical day looks like:
· 1.Design, develop, and maintain embedded firmware for PMI (Power Management Interface) and communication MCU platforms.
· 2.Develop firmware for ARM Cortex-M based microcontrollers, including bootloaders, peripheral drivers, middleware, and application software.
· 3.Perform board bring-up, hardware validation, and firmware debugging on custom embedded systems.
· 4.Develop telemetry, monitoring, control, and fault management functions for Power modules
· 5.Design and validate firmware update mechanisms, including bootloader and UDS-based firmware update solutions.
· 6.Debug hardware-software integration issues using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, and CAN analyzers.
· 7.Collaborate with hardware, validation, manufacturing, and customer engineering teams to investigate and resolve technical issues.
· 8.Develop test tools and automation scripts to improve firmware validation efficiency.
· 9.Participate in technical reviews and contribute to system architecture discussions.
The experience we are looking to add to our team:
· Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
· Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in consumer PC, industrial PC, laptops, RISC architecture, or networking-related products.
· Strong communication skills, self-motivation, and the ability to navigate ambiguity effectively
Nice to have:
· Experience with OCP ORV3 rack architectures.
